metadata.title: ECDSA weak-nonce failures: the present-tense crypto footgun

notes: Ported from bubble-map ECDSA-nonce tracker; anchors the local ecdsafail-cli skill. Two distinct failure classes on one primitive: (1) present-tense implementation bugs (nonce reuse/bias -> closed-form or lattice key recovery), and (2) the future Shor break. PQC answers both.

entities.name: ECDSA
entities.notes: Elliptic Curve DSA over secp256k1/P-256. Signature security collapses if the per-signature nonce k is reused (same r -> solve for private key d, closed-form) or biased/partially known (lattice attack on the Hidden Number Problem).

entities.name: Weak_Nonce_Failure
entities.notes: In the wild: Brengel & Rossow parsed 647M BTC signatures, found 1,068 reused r-values across 4,433 keys; the 2013 Android SecureRandom bug reused k and drained wallets; Biased Nonce Sense (2019) and 'Chain Reactions' (2026, Polygon MEV) recovered ETH/BTC keys.

entities.name: ECDSA_fail_Tracker
entities.notes: The 'ECDSA.fail' premise: a living scanner/disclosure thread continuously cataloging chains and libraries for repeated/biased/related nonces and surfacing affected signatures. Local analogue: the ecdsafail-cli skill.

entities.name: RFC6979_Deterministic
entities.notes: Derives k deterministically as HMAC(message-hash, secret-key) - same message always yields the same k, removing RNG dependence and eliminating the reuse/bias vector for correct implementations.

entities.name: EdDSA_Ed25519
entities.notes: Derives the nonce deterministically from private key + message by design, structurally preventing RNG-driven reuse; increasingly preferred for new systems. Does NOT address the quantum break.

entities.name: QRL
entities.notes: The Quantum Resistant Ledger uses stateful hash-based signatures (XMSS) instead of ECDSA - positioned explicitly as post-ECDSA/post-quantum.

entities.name: Bitcoin
entities.notes: Authorizes spends with ECDSA over secp256k1 (Schnorr/Taproot added 2021, but ECDSA dominates legacy UTXOs) - every legacy signature's safety rests on nonce quality.

entities.name: Ethereum
entities.notes: EOAs sign with ECDSA/secp256k1; the same nonce-quality dependence applies chain-wide.

edges.instrument: Biased Nonce Sense / Chain Reactions key recovery
Shor recovers private key from public key
edges.notes: Separate from the nonce footgun - no implementation error needed.
